BundleInfo.name: ChimeraX-InstantMap
BundleInfo.Author: Lukas W. Bauer (AI-assisted development by Claude, Anthropic)
BundleInfo.Synopsis: Auto-refreshing MRC/MAP/CryoSPARC file browser for Cryo-EM SPA and Cryo-ET STA workflows.
BundleInfo.Description: A tool for browsing a directory for .mrc and .map files with automatic refresh, including a dedicated browser for CryoSPARC project/job output directories (volumes, half-maps, masks, .bild files), SSH/SFTP browsing of remote projects, and a RELION Job History tab with per-job state/artifact detection, a job-tree figure and a methods draft. It also makes RELION-style soft masks from maps (instantmap mask), builds job trees and tables headlessly with optional JSON output (instantmap tree|table|methods), and lets the reliontree browser view open maps in this ChimeraX (instantmap listen). Built by Lukas W. Bauer with Claude (Anthropic) as AI copilot.

Classifiers.ChimeraXClassifier: ChimeraX :: Tool :: InstantMap :: Volume Data :: Browse and open MRC files
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap tree :: Volume Data :: Build a RELION job lineage tree from the command line
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap table :: Volume Data :: Build a RELION job lineage table (CSV/Markdown) from the command line
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap methods :: Volume Data :: Draft a methods-section paragraph from a RELION job lineage
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap listen :: Volume Data :: Let reliontree open maps in this ChimeraX (private file queue, no network port)
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap hint :: Volume Data :: Show or hide the reliontree tip printed at startup
ChimeraX :: Command :: instantmap mask :: Volume Data :: Make a RELION-style soft mask from a map (low-pass, threshold, extend, soft edge)
